summary: conv-context-next preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated bundled payload
details: On install, the package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime for the host platform from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/` and then executes the package-shipped `math_init.js` under that runtime (falling back to a locally-installed Bun if present). `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line file heavily obfuscated with obfuscator.io patterns (rotated string-array shuffle helper, hex-named identifiers, character-code decoding) and carries a `@bun`/`@bun-cjs` banner indicating it was compiled specifically for Bun — likely to evade Node-based static review. The package advertises itself as a 'Conversation context manager' and its `main` (index.js) is a small benign helper over lodash and a time interpreter that never references `setup.mjs` or `math_init.js`. Pulling a second language runtime to execute an opaque bundled script at install has no relationship to the declared library purpose, and the alternate-runtime execution is the vehicle that runs the hidden payload on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
